projects.headline: 6-Unit Multifamily
projects.summary: Six-unit multifamily investment — $3,499,900 for the entire property. New construction in Dania Beach; each unit has 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and approximately 1,406 SF of living space.
about: RARE INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY – SIX-UNIT NEW-CONSTRUCTION MULTIFAMILY PROPERTY IN BROWARD COUNTY! An exceptional opportunity to acquire a multifamily property consisting of six newly constructed residential units in one of Broward County’s highly desirable rental corridors. The asking price of $3,499,900 is for the entire six-unit property, not per unit. Ideal for investors seeking to expand their portfolios with a low-maintenance asset offering strong rental income potential and long-term appreciation opportunities. Each of the six units features 3 spacious bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and approximately 1,406 SF of thoughtfully designed living space, complete with independent utilities and individually fenced areas for added privacy and convenience. All six units share the same layout. Built with modern finishes and functional layouts tailored to today’s rental market, these residences offer the advantages of brand-new construction, reduced maintenance expenses, and attractive rental and resale potential. Strategically located with convenient access to Griffin Road, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport, major highways, beautiful beaches, and the iconic Hard Rock Hotel & Casino. A rare opportunity to acquire all six new-construction units together in one multifamily investment, combining operational efficiency, strong rental income potential, and long-term value. Seller will deliver the Certificate of Occupancy (CO) at or prior to closing. Easy to show! Note: Due to landscaping and asphalt driveway work not yet being completed, some marketing images have been enhanced with AI to illustrate the projected finished appearance.

about: Brand-New Construction in the Heart of Dania Beach!

This stunning two-story residence offers 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and 1,956 SF of living area (2,256 total SF) on a spacious 4,950 SF corner lot. Featuring a contemporary open-concept design with modern porcelain tile flooring throughout the main living areas, a designer kitchen with sleek modern cabinetry and included stainless steel appliances, this home blends style and functionality. The spacious primary suite features an elegant bathroom with dual vanities and modern finishes. Additional features include a spacious garage and thoughtfully designed living spaces ideal for entertaining.

Estimated completion in approximately 2 months. Conveniently located just 5 minutes from Dania Beach, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport, beautiful beaches, shopping, dining, entertainment, and major highways.
An exceptional opportunity to own a brand-new home in one of South Florida's fastest-growing communities.

Multiple financing programs available. Buyers who finance with the seller's preferred lender may receive up to an additional $3,500 toward closing costs, subject to financial profile, loan approval, and transaction terms.

projects.headline: Rebuilt Pool Home
projects.summary: Move-in-ready 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath pool home rebuilt from the ground up in 2026, with 1,970 SF of living space and a private backyard oasis.
about: Rebuilt from the ground up in 2026, this stunning pool home combines modern luxury, quality craftsmanship, and peace of mind. Featuring an expansive open-concept layout filled with natural light, elegant porcelain flooring, and high-end finishes throughout. The kitchen showcases contemporary cabinetry, quartz countertops with a waterfall island, and sleek modern details. Offering 3 spacious bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, including an exceptionally large primary suite with a generous walk-in closet. Beautifully appointed bathrooms feature double-sink vanities, stylish showers, and premium fixtures. A dedicated laundry room with a utility sink adds convenience. Everything is brand new, down to the smallest detail! Enjoy a high-efficiency central A/C system, impact-resistant windows and doors, and new pool equipment, designed for energy efficiency, low maintenance, and potential insurance savings. Step outside to your private backyard oasis, featuring a resurfaced swimming pool with fresh Sky Blue plaster, beautiful landscaping, a fully fenced yard, and spacious driveway. Ideally located in Dania Beach, minutes from the beach, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport, shopping, casinos, restaurants, and entertainment. A rare opportunity to own a brand-new pool home in a desirable South Florida coastal location. Move-in ready and built to impress!
